title: Karbala ke Maqtal Me Arbayee ka Matam Hai
body:
Karbala ke maqtal mein arbaeen ka matam hai
Karbala mein aa pahonchi le ke khaafela Zainab, kar rahi hain bhayi ki qhabar par buka Zainab, arbaeen ko aayi hain baniy-e-aza Zainab, har taraf fazaon mein bekasi ka aalam hai
Munharif zamana hain Fatima ki jayi se, ho chuka hain dil tukde sadmae judayi se, wakheya aseeri ka keh rahi hain bhayi se, har taraf fazaon mein bekasi ka aalam hai
Aap ki Sakina ko laa saki na mein bhayi, khoon bhare hue kurte mein usse hoon dafnayi, khabr uski zindaan maien main bana ke hoon aayi, har taraf fazaon mein bekasi ka aalam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain nashaan rassi ke haye mere baazo par, chheen li laeenaon ne farqe paak se chadar, kehrahi hain bhayi se dard dil ka roro kar, har taraf fazaon mein bekasi ka aalam hai
Tera sar kata bhaiyya mera sar khula bhaiyya, khaid hogayi ban mein aale mustafa bhaiyya, hum ghareebaon ka koi tha na aasra bhaiyya, har taraf fazaon mein bekasi ka aalam hai
Karwaan nouhaon ka ta ba Karbala pahoncha, dil halaye deta hai aye hasan tera nouha, kar rahi hai roro kar bain saniye zehra, har taraf fazaon mein bekasi ka aalam hai...
